calibration: none: the parent's risk-date forecast (none: fitted on risk-date label days only and exactly 0 on every other day), changed by one thing: a ridge logistic on spread_bps, sofr_p75_iorb_bps, sofr_p99_iorb_bps and iorb_announced_change_bps serves every day that is not a risk date; then the 'gate' false-alarm control on the days that are not risk dates: on a day that is not a risk date the component's probability is kept only if it is strictly above the quantile (nearest rank) of the component's forecasts on the days that were not risk dates among the previous window scored days; then on a day that is not a risk date the forecast is kept only if the tail spread (sofr_p99_iorb_bps) is at or below the 0.75 quantile of its readings over the previous 250 scored days (at least 60; else 0); scored under settlements dated from the auction announcement (metadata/settlement_announcement_dating.json) and the H.4.1 weeklies read per release (metadata/h41_release_dating.json); metadata/every_day_conditioning_601.json; then a floor on the days that are not risk dates: the walk-forward rate of pressure days among the earlier such days, observable at the block's fit (group_calibration.walk_forward_floor); metadata/tailcap_floor_610.json
